payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics comparing NUS and ABUS, indicating how much NUS outperformed ABUS in terms of success rates and average rewards.

claims.text: The NUS achieved a success rate of 93.4% and an average reward of 13.8, while the ABUS achieved a success rate of 90.0% and an average reward of 13.3.
In cross-model evaluation, the NUS policies achieved an average success rate of 94.0% when tested on ABUS, compared to 99.5% for ABUS tested on itself.
The NUS outperformed the ABUS in both evaluation tasks, indicating superior performance overall.
